Operations not yet complete, aborted or failed, across connections;
a begin beyond it is `busy` (`transferCapacity`).

receiptRetentionMs.description: How long a finished operation's receipt is answered.

TransferLimits.description: Caller quotas of one operation; each at most its advertised ceiling.

TransferOnExisting.description: What a materialize does with an existing destination.

oneOf.description: Refuse at begin (`alreadyExists`).
Replace it atomically at commit.

TransferOperationParams.description:
Params of `transfer/advance`, `transfer/getStatus`, `transfer/commit`
and `transfer/abort`: each names only the operation.

TransferPhase.description:
Where an operation stands; see the module docs for the order per
selection kind.

oneOf.description:
The daemon walks a tree: the capture source, or the destination of a
materialize. Advance until the phase changes.

Capture: the inventory is sealed and pageable. Materialize: waiting
for appended entries.
Waiting for the content of `transfer/listMissing` digests.
The daemon assembles the staged tree. Advance until `ready`.
Ready for `transfer/commit`.
Stopped by an error; see `error`.
Read a file or tree out of the environment.

Write a tree into the environment, replacing `destination` atomically
at commit.

Write exactly one file with `fs/writeFile` semantics: staged,
atomic, an existing target keeps its permissions, an in-root symlink
at `destination` is followed.

TransferSkip.description: An entry a capture left out.

path.description: Absent when the entry's name is not UTF-8.

TransferSkipReason.description: Why a capture left an entry out.

oneOf.description: `symlinks: skip`, or a dangling link under `symlinks: expandInside`.
`specialFiles: skip`.
The name is not UTF-8; such entries are always skipped.

TransferStatus.description:
The operation's status: the response of `transfer/begin`,
`transfer/advance`, `transfer/getStatus`, `transfer/append`,
`transfer/commit` and `transfer/abort`.

deadlineAtMs.description: When `maxDurationMs` runs out for an active operation.

entryCount.description: Entries in the inventory so far.

error.description: Why the operation failed; present exactly when `phase` is `failed`.

receiptExpiresAtMs.description:
When the receipt of a finished (complete, aborted or failed)
operation stops being answered; afterwards calls are `notFound`
(`expired`).

reusedBytes.description: Content bytes satisfied from files already at the destination.

skipped.description:
The first
`MAX_LISTED_SKIPS` entries a
capture left out under its policies.

skippedEntryCount.description:
Total number of entries left out, listed or not; present whenever it
is not zero.

totalBytes.description: File bytes in the inventory so far.

transferredBytes.description: Content bytes moved over the wire.

TreeContent.description:
What a tree entry is: a scan entry or a transfer inventory entry.
Digests identify raw file bytes, not paths or modes.

digest.description:
Scans: present when `includeDigests` was set. Transfer
inventories: always present; an appended file entry without it
is `invalidParams`.

TreeFilter.description:
Which entries a walk visits. The default visits everything except
hidden and ignored entries.

exclude.description: Drop entries matching any pattern; a matching directory is pruned.

include.description: Select entries matching any pattern; empty selects every entry.

includeHidden.description: Visit entries whose name starts with `.`.

includeIgnored.description: Visit entries that ignore files exclude.

maxDepth.description:
Deepest entry depth visited: the root's direct children are depth
1, so `1` selects direct children only. Unbounded when absent.

TreePath.description:
A relative, normalized path below a selected root: segments joined by
`/`, without empty, `.` or `..` segments. The single segment `.` names
the root itself. At most 4096 bytes. Used for scan, inventory and
transfer entries.

oneOf.description: Create or replace.

Only create; an existing entry is `failedPrecondition`
(`createCondition`).

Only replace; a missing file is `failedPrecondition`
(`createCondition`).

WriteFileParams.description:
`fs/writeFile` params. The write is staged in the target's directory and
published by an atomic rename: readers see the old or the new content,
never a mix. An existing target keeps its permissions. A symlink at
`path` whose target stays inside the root is followed like any path: the
final target is replaced and the link itself is kept (a dangling link
creates its target, subject to `create`); a link that leaves the root is
`permissionDenied` (`outsideRoot`). A special file is
`failedPrecondition` (`notRegularFile`), a directory
`failedPrecondition` (`isDirectory`). The parent of the final target
must exist.

data.description:
At most `limits.filesystem.maxWriteFileBytes`; larger files go
through `transfer/*` with a `writeFile` selection.

executable.description:
Set the execute bits (the read bits' pattern). Without it a new file
gets the default mode and an existing file keeps its mode.

ifMatch.description:
Write only when the current file's version equals this token;
otherwise `failedPrecondition` (`ifMatchFailed`).

closeInput.description:
Close the input after `data`: end of file on a pipe, `VEOF` on a
PTY. Applied only when every byte of `data` was accepted.

data.description: Bytes for the process's input pipe or PTY.

acceptedBytes.description:
Leading bytes of `data` queued to the process's writer. Fewer than
sent (possibly 0) means the input queue is full: resend the rest
later.

WriteTransferContentParams.description:
`transfer/write` params: upload content for a missing digest. Chunks for
one digest arrive in order; an identical chunk may be retried.
Different digests may be uploaded concurrently.

offset.description: Must equal the digest's next expected offset.

nextOffset.description:
The digest's next expected offset; equal to its size once complete
and verified.
